title: QuanTiMedAI: Quantum-Enhanced Time-Series Model Guided by Agentic AI for Cardiac Arrest Mortality Prediction

claim.summary: QuanTiMedAI uses an LLM to select clinical features and severity weights with cross-validation feedback, then trains a quantum-enhanced recurrent mortality predictor.

modules.name: Outcome-guided clinical feature and severity selection
modules.scope_reason: The selected feature set is optimized for cardiac-arrest mortality, then frozen before downstream model evaluation.
